  "pros": [
    "Able to pull in different data from multiple platforms, which is crucial for comprehensive marketing insights.",
    "Effectively visualizes data analysis, enabling clear display of business intelligence dashboards.",
    "Facilitates showing data to clients, supporting transparent reporting in a marketing context."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "The tool is quite expensive, which can be a consideration for a mid-sized company.",
    "Pages sometimes take a while to load, potentially impacting efficiency during dashboard reviews.",
    "Connecting third-party applications can be difficult initially, adding complexity to data integration."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Senior Digital Innovation Manager likely found Looker to be a highly functional and user-friendly tool for displaying business intelligence dashboards, especially appreciating its data integration and visualization capabilities for marketing and client reporting. However, the cost and occasional performance issues with page loading or third-party integrations were noted as areas of frustration. Despite these minor drawbacks, the overall experience was very positive given its long-term use and high ratings."
